The 2026 Benelux Ascend Series Summer Playoffs ("BAS 2026 Summer Playoffs") marks the second year of the Benelux League of Legends secondary circuit organized by Once Upon A Team. It serves as a direct pathway to the Road Of Legends. During the Summer Playoffs, six teams compete in a double-elimination bracket to be crowned Champions.

Overview[]

Format[]

  • Top six teams from the summer split participate
    • Seeds 1 through 4 receive an upper bracket berth
    • Seeds 5 and 6 start in the lower bracket
  • Double-Elimination Bracket
  • The first seed chooses whether to face the third- or fourth-seeded team in its first match, while the second seed is assigned the remaining team
  • Round 1 matches are best-of-three (BO3)
  • All other matches are best-of-five (BO5)
  • Champions earn a place in the Road Of Legends 2027 Promotion
  • Losers of the Lower Bracket Round 1 are sent to the BAS 2027 Promotion Tournament
